info.title: AlphaKolect API
info.description: Generated from packages/contracts — do not edit by hand. Money amounts are kobo as exact decimal digit strings (e.g. "150000" = ₦1,500.00).

post.summary: Sign in with email and password

200.description: Signed in, or a second step is required

409.description: MEMBERSHIP_SELECTION_REQUIRED — only after correct credentials, when several memberships are eligible: no session yet; a short-lived selection challenge is set as an HttpOnly cookie. Continue with GET /v1/auth/login/memberships and POST /v1/auth/login/select.

post.summary: Create a business and its owner account; a verification email follows

post.summary: Confirm an email address with the token from the verification email

204.description: Email verified (and the business activated); the owner can now sign in

400.description: INVALID_OR_EXPIRED_TOKEN — the same for every reason; or VALIDATION_ERROR

post.summary: Send a new verification email
Email a password reset link (or, for an account that has never had a password, a setup link)
Set a new password with a reset link; every session of the account ends

204.description: Password changed; every session revoked and this browser signed out

403.description: FORBIDDEN — only the business owner

409.description: INVALID_ASSIGNMENT — the role/branch is not an active one of this business (or set for an agent); ALREADY_MEMBER

post.summary: Withdraw a pending invitation (owner)

403.description: FORBIDDEN — only the business owner

404.description: NOT_FOUND — also for another business’s items

post.summary: Join a business with an invitation link and the password of the invited account (then sign in as usual)

204.description: Joined: the membership exists from now on

400.description: INVALID_INVITATION — the same for every reason (link, email, password, expiry, the business); or VALIDATION_ERROR

post.summary: Agent sign-in (mobile): tokens in the body, or the businesses to choose from

401.description: INVALID_CREDENTIALS — identical for every reason, including "not an agent"

403.description: EMAIL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED — only after correct credentials

401.description: INVALID_OR_EXPIRED_TOKEN — the same for every reason (also for a web refresh token)

get.summary: The signed-in agent’s membership and business, as of this request

NewPassword.description: 12-128 characters, no composition rules; very common passwords are refused (422 WEAK_PASSWORD, D10)

VerifyMfaRequest.description: Either the current authenticator code or one recovery code

CatalogStatus.description: Archived items keep their history; their name may be reused

PlatformStaffRole.description: A label only: it grants nothing (D4)

CreateInvitationRequest.description: The answer is the same whether or not the email already has an AlphaKolect account

AmountMinor.description: Non-negative amount in minor units (kobo) as a decimal digit string

Currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Only NGN is accepted.

requestId.description: Echoed in the x-request-id response header

ErrorResponse.description: Every error response uses this envelope

Session.description: The signed-in session (no tokens: those are in HttpOnly cookies)

VerificationPending.description: If the email can receive a verification link, one has been sent. Identical for every email.

PasswordEmailPending.description: If the email has an account, a link has been sent to it. Identical for every email.

TotpEnrollment.description: Shown once. Not stored by the client.

MembershipChoices.description: The businesses this account may sign in to

MerchantLifecycle.description: The merchant’s status after the change

CurrentMembership.description: The caller’s own membership and effective permissions, as of this request

MerchantProfile.description: The business the session belongs to

Role.description: A merchant-defined staff role and the permissions it grants

PermissionCatalog.description: The active merchant permissions, by identifier

MemberList.description: Every member, oldest first; nextCursor is always null for now

Member.description: A member of the business (owner, staff or agent)

PlatformMerchant.description: A business, as the platform team sees it

PlatformMemberList.description: One business’s members (owner, staff and agents), newest first

PlatformStaffMember.description: A member of the AlphaKolect platform team

InvitationList.description: Every invitation, newest first; nextCursor is always null for now

cookieSession.name: __Secure-ak_at
cookieSession.description: Web audiences (platform, merchant): HttpOnly access-token cookie (ADR-14 D7)

csrfToken.name: X-CSRF-Token
csrfToken.description: Echo of the __Secure-ak_csrf cookie, required on state-changing cookie requests

bearer.description: Mobile audiences (agent, customer): EdDSA-signed access token (ADR-14 D6)
